requirements.text: You are working in C# or Java right now and you are already using AI as part of how you work day to day, not as a talking point but as a real part of your process. You know what it means to take a project from nothing to production and you have done it before. This would be a great next step if you are ready to move from a strong second role into somewhere that gives you real autonomy and visibility.
